##### Project general facts

Uniestate Prime Tower by Uniestate Properties is a freehold residential tower offering studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments. The building features a calm beige facade and a thoughtfully planned design that combines elegance, comfort and value for money. The project was created by an experienced team of designers and engineers, reflecting the developer's focus on quality and attention to detail.

The tower is surrounded by a beautifully landscaped garden, offering pleasant views and space for relaxing evening walks after work. Residents also benefit from dedicated parking spaces, adding everyday convenience to life in the building.

The apartments are finished in harmonious colour schemes and patterns that create a soothing living environment. The kitchens come fully equipped, with sinks, faucets and other key fittings from high-end European brands. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise the interiors to their taste.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), a fast-growing residential community in Dubai. The neighbourhood is known for its distinctive circular layout, which combines modern residential buildings with green open spaces.

JVC features tree-lined streets, quiet parks and a mix of villas and apartments, creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere. The community offers a peaceful setting away from the busier parts of the city while remaining well connected to the rest of Dubai.

Residents of JVC have access to schools, shopping centres, parks and recreational facilities within the community. This makes the area a convenient choice for families, working professionals and investors.
